patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, Braze, Firebase Analytics and the advertising identifier and install-referrer collection, and switches off Google measurement, Crashlytics and Sessions upload and Facebook advertiser-ID collection in the manifest. The game…
Blocks the ad SDK bridge: SDK initialization reports failure and every rewarded or interstitial request reports the game's own no-fill error, so no ad network is ever contacted.

Declares Candy Crush Soda Saga a parked game app, so Android Auto and car hosts like DriveDeck and Gearslip list it on the car screen by themselves. Android Auto still needs Unknown sources in its developer settings for a patched app.
